topic: Buying a four thousand dollar passive income course from a guru vs checking the refund policy and complaints (Elliott vs Cynthia)

scenes.narration: The guru showed a rented mansion and sold four thousand dollar courses. Case file 0116. Time of incident, late night.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named detective cash, sharp blue eyes, gray fedora hat, beige trench coat, five o'clock shadow, holding magnifying glass and a manila file folder labeled with dollar signs, detective cash in a noir office looking at a laptop showing a guru in front of a mansion with a tag reading RENTED, comic burst banner reads CASE FILE 0116, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Elliott and Cynthia both see the same ad. Make ten thousand a month, guaranteed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man elliott and woman cynthia watching a phone ad reading TEN THOUSAND A MONTH GUARANTEED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The free webinar ends with a countdown and a four thousand dollar offer.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a webinar screen with a countdown clock and a button reading ENROLL NOW FOUR THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Elliott puts it on a credit card before the timer hits zero.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man elliott typing his card number as a timer flashes red, sweat drops, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The course is recycled videos. The real training costs twelve thousand more.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a screen of blurry old videos, a pop up reading UPGRADE TO MASTERMIND TWELVE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The income screenshots were edited. Refunds are denied after seven days.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a screenshot with an obvious edit mark, a policy reading NO REFUNDS AFTER SEVEN DAYS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Elliott is four thousand deeper in debt with nothing to sell.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man elliott holding a credit card bill reading FOUR THOUSAND, an empty online store, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cynthia searches the guru name plus the word complaints.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman cynthia at a laptop typing a search, results read COMPLAINTS and LAWSUIT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She finds a regulator case and hundreds of refund complaints.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a screen showing a consumer agency page with a case number and a long list of complaints, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She spends forty dollars on a library book about the same skill.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman cynthia reading a library book, a receipt reads FORTY DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Elliott lost four thousand. Cynthia learned the skill for forty.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man elliott beside a big bill, woman cynthia beside a small receipt and a finished project, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Guaranteed income is a sales script. Search the complaints first. Case closed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named detective cash, sharp blue eyes, gray fedora hat, beige trench coat, five o'clock shadow, holding magnifying glass and a manila file folder labeled with dollar signs, detective cash stamping a file CASE CLOSED in his noir office, a board reads SEARCH THE COMPLAINTS FIRST, kids comic book illustration
